<p align="center"><strong>The garden gate is open. Nobody gets left behind.</strong></p>


<p align="center">The leaf bell opens the garden exit. Your cat clings to your shoulder as you descend. The road home is visible beyond the iron gate.</p>

<p align="center">A pumpkin beside the path whispers, &quot;My name was Ada.&quot; The cat touches its carved mouth. In the attic window, Elias holds out the cup with a trembling hand.</p>

<p align="center">A trail of unlit lanterns leads toward a greenhouse. A note tied to the first post reads: &quot;The gate saves one guest. The beacon can save every name. Five parts remain. - Elias&quot;</p>
